description: Use this skill only when the user explicitly asks to draft, polish, revise, or export a formal Chinese official document such as 请示、报告、汇报材料、公文草拟. The skill should first gather authoritative policy basis from available web search/fetch tools or user-provided/local materials, then draft the document in formal official Chinese style. Do not use this skill for general policy Q&A, legal retrieval, ordinary article writing, or broad research tasks.
